fx_graph: independent typed logical DAG; no rule DSL included
rules:
Implement the supplied logical graph exactly, including every named output.
Only @hc.func("c,p,...") decorated functions: golden plus at most 16 scalar-Expr helpers.
Golden parameters must match layout.inputs in order, followed by zero_ct; all are c.
Every physical layout.inputs chunk is encrypted separately and repeated across
16384 slots. P=layout.input_slot_period. Different logical tensors never share a chunk.
Return one ciphertext per physical output chunk in ciphertext-index order, with
its chunk values in the C-order prefix, repeated every P slots. Other slots are unobserved.
Arithmetic +,-,*, unary minus requires a ciphertext operand. Public constants are immutable
scalar or length-P values in public_constants; finite literals with magnitude<=1024 allowed.
Positive rotate(k) reads slot j+k; only positive powers of two below P are callable.
Compose rotations for other displacements. Linear is a reduction, not elementwise multiply.
zero_ct is client-encrypted zero, not an extra model input or a bootstrap substitute.
Compiler owns security, scale, level, rescale, modswitch and relinearization.
Helpers have typed scalar c/p positional parameters, no recursion, defaults, kwargs or imports.
Public bounded range loops, assignments, tuple/list unpacking and final returns are permitted.
np.array(data,dtype=object), literal indexing/slicing, reshape/flatten/copy/transpose/T/item
operate on whole Expr storage: rank<=4, cells<=16, never ciphertext slots.
Array-left +,-,* uses outer-storage broadcasting. Scalar +=,-=,*= rebind; array name-target
augmentation mutates shared storage, copies remain independent. No subscript writes.
Starred calls expand the first axis into scalar Expr arguments. No encrypted conditions,
while, arbitrary calls, I/O, network, bootstrap, raw level changes or hidden data access.
Expanded work<=4096, golden work<=1024, source<=65536 bytes, AST and sandbox bounds apply.
Do not change weights, layout, reference, numerical thresholds or test inputs.
Return only response-schema JSON. Numerical correctness requires real encrypted validation.

Chunk bindings for unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v3: logical_inputs declares tensors, inputs binds physical
DSL parameters. For each entry, flatten that logical tensor in C order, take
[offset:offset+elements], then zero-pad to P. Chunks are encrypted independently.
Each named output lists chunks with immutable ciphertext index, offset and elements.
Reassemble via output_selectors in named-output order. Cross-chunk operations must
implement logical tensor semantics; rotating a chunk alone is not a whole-tensor rotation.
Intermediate layouts are candidate choices; immutable input/output bindings cannot change.
At most sixteen model chunks plus zero_ct and sixteen output chunks; existing budgets apply.

Capacity ABI unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v3: resource_profile and physical bindings are immutable.
This request selects the general-tensors-v1 profile (logical rank 1..32). At most sixteen input chunks and sixteen output chunks;
append exactly one trusted encrypted zero_ct to the ordered x0,x1,... entry parameters.
Logical tensors retain their declared shapes and names. Flatten each separately in C order,
partition into P-element chunks, pad each final chunk, and repeat each chunk across 16384 slots.
Return all physical ciphertexts in the frozen output order; selectors decode only logical elements.
Every logical operation must include all chunks, including tails. A chunk rotation is not a
whole-tensor rotation. Reductions exclude padded slots, including padding changed by public bias.
Native helpers retain sixteen parameters and object storage retains sixteen cells.
Source, AST, work, sandbox, depth, rotations and security limits remain unchanged.
Logical input/output element limits: 4096/4096.
Individual operators retain their registered rank and axis restrictions. Object-array construction bounds remain unchanged.
Static transpose/permute use the tensor_route masks from the frozen packing descriptor; they route logical C-order elements across chunks.

Public packing capacity-public-tensors-v9: bindings name immutable length-P
vectors, not extra model parameters. Linear strategies are public layout plans.
For tensor_route and pool_gather with baby_step/giant_step, the registered mask
is pre-rotated: mask[j] is the destination coefficient at (j-giant_step) mod P.
The complete route reads input_chunk at the declared step and places its values
in output_chunk; shifts spanning chunks use their declared source/destination.
spatial_window factors an unpadded average window into flat sums, then selects
only valid spatial anchors. spatial_windows.axes gives each count and flat
stride; pool_shift offset is a zero-filled flat displacement before pooling
gather, not an independent tensor input. pool_gather includes the average
divisor. Intermediate windows across row/channel boundaries are never selected.
These plans change physical routing only; the declared model mathematics,
weights, layouts, resource limits and numerical reference remain fixed.

spatial_stream sums a public list of offsets within one source chunk before
gathering valid anchors. spatial_streams lists input_chunk and offsets; stream
in pool_stream_gather selects that list entry, while input_chunk records the
original physical input. Gather masks include the average divisor.
tiled_row_sum Linear first places independent rows at a power-of-two stride,
performs a row-local weighted sum, selects row starts, then packs output rows.
linear_tiles.method, public row weights and row masks bind this layout.

channel_affine preserves inference BatchNorm: bn_gain and bn_offset are public
length-P vectors derived from the frozen statistics, gain, bias and epsilon.
Each output chunk equals input_chunk * bn_gain + bn_offset. Tail positions
remain zero and are outside the logical output.
aligned_suffix sums complete disjoint power-of-two suffix rows. suffix_windows
binds the row width and count; suffix_gather observes only row starts after
rotations/additions at offsets 1,2,...,width/2. Masks include the mean divisor
when applicable. Unobserved rolling-window positions are not tensor outputs.

Static slice routes preserve C-order tensor indexing: starts, stops and positive
steps are model attributes. tensor_route masks bind each source chunk and output
chunk, including zero-filled tails. Removing or inserting singleton dimensions
uses reshape after selection and does not rotate ciphertext slots by itself.

Public weight descriptor contract v2:
Large public tensors retain shape and content-hash descriptors.
math_roles supplies checked public mathematical values and exact bindings for
scalar operands and polynomial coefficients. Other public tensors retain existing
constant_origins block/layout roles and descriptors; no scalar Plain is required
for each tensor element.
Coefficient index is the declared ascending degree/basis index. pN numbering
has no mathematical meaning. Use the listed immutable Plain names and retain
every nonzero coefficient. exact_zero denotes mathematical zero, not a request
to produce a transparent ciphertext. A zero result requires the existing trusted
encrypted-zero capability. Tensor/scalar equality does not change logical shape,
layout, matrix semantics, rotation keys or backend capability. These are public
mathematical roles, not a DSL implementation or private numerical answers.

semantic_guidance.packing: common periodic inputs, named packed outputs
semantic_guidance.scope: bounded native construction, no unrestricted Python

math_roles.scope: public mathematical values and exact prebound roles; no DSL answer

generation_guidance.entry_rule: Define exactly one top-level golden. The header has no body; implement the supplied graph yourself. Use the literal decorator call with parentheses and the exact c signature, never bare @hc.func.
generation_guidance.parameter_rule: Use exactly these unannotated positional names, without defaults, varargs or keyword-only parameters. zero_ct is the final trusted ciphertext argument.
generation_guidance.constant_rule: Use public_constants keys directly as prebound names. Do not define replacement weights or load a dictionary/file. hc and np are provided by the trusted runner; do not import them.
generation_guidance.helper_rule: Each additional native helper needs its own literal @hc.func c/p signature matching its unannotated positional parameters. Helper c/p types need not match golden.
generation_guidance.rotation_rule: Call ciphertext.rotate(k), never hc.rotate(...). The request rules determine permitted displacements.
generation_guidance.output_rule: Return exactly layout.output_ciphertexts whole ciphertext expressions in the frozen output order; object-array cells are whole expressions, not slots.
generation_guidance.authority: This guidance clarifies the existing rules; it adds no allowed syntax, helper, resource budget or backend capability.

logical_model_semantics.scope: Mathematical definition of the public input graph; no DSL implementation or test answers.
logical_model_semantics.ordering: Named input/output order and node output order are significant. Tensor flattening always uses C order.
logical_model_semantics.attributes: All required attributes are explicit in each node; no implicit framework defaults are to be inferred.
logical_model_semantics.broadcasting: Align dimensions from the right. Each pair must be equal or contain 1. Public broadcasting cannot expand the encrypted operand shape.
logical_model_semantics.axes: Negative existing axes are normalized against input rank; stack inserts an axis and normalizes against output rank.
logical_model_semantics.layout_boundary: Model operators act on logical tensors. Padding, repeated periods, chunks and Expr object-array storage are representation details, not extra mathematical elements.

operations.conv1d: Cross-correlation, no kernel reversal. Input is [C,spatial...] or [N,C,spatial...]. Public weight is [Cout,Cin/groups,kernel...] and optional bias [Cout]. For each output channel, sum only the corresponding contiguous input-channel group. Source coordinate is dst*stride-padding+kernel_index*dilation on each spatial axis; out-of-range input is zero. Add bias once per output value. Spatial size is floor((input_size+2*padding-dilation*(kernel_size-1)-1)/stride)+1.
operations.linear: Inputs are x, public weight W, and optional public bias b. W has shape [out_features,in_features]. y[...,j]=sum_k x[...,k]*W[j,k]+b[j]; omit b if absent. Contract the last axis of x.
operations.reshape: Keep the C-order sequence of logical values and reinterpret attrs.shape. At most one -1 infers its dimension from the unchanged element count.

generation_guidance.encrypted_zero_rule: zero_ct is a genuine client-encrypted zero. Preserve exact zero semantics without depending on transparent self-cancellation or decoding any intermediate. Do not change encryption, runtime checks or keys.

typed_values: Distinguish public numbers/numeric arrays, object arrays of complete Expr cells, and packed slots inside a ciphertext. Container reshape/transpose does not move ciphertext slots.
Use dtype=object for arrays containing Expr or Empty. Numeric np.array/asarray accepts public numeric data only. float/int/item never decrypt a ciphertext.
Plain encoding accepts a scalar or a one-dimensional vector of length 1 or P. Explicitly reshape public arrays to that encoding shape; matrix shape alone is not a packed Plain.

np.empty takes positional shape and dtype=object; np.full takes positional shape and fill plus dtype=object. Initialize empty cells before arithmetic. Only the request's admitted methods and signatures are available.
Unary plus on an object array and unary plus on an individual ciphertext are different operations. Do not infer arbitrary NumPy/Expr methods from Python familiarity.
At the pinned frontend, Empty - Expr resolves to Expr, not -Expr. Empty is a symbolic construction identity, not encrypted zero; use zero_ct for a client-encrypted numeric zero.
contribution: Integrate the required construction into the correct computation: public coefficients, indices, control, storage or expression assembly. Do not add a bias merely to create an observable witness.
The required operation must execute and influence a named output under bounded intervention. Dead code, cancelled values, unused cells and observations confined to padding do not qualify.
Use the actual typed operation. A custom helper named update/items/reshape does not count as the dictionary or array method with that name.
For list/tuple materialization, consume the resulting container in a way that depends on its contents. Syntax occurrence alone is insufficient.
Counter requirements describe an executed operation at a source span, not a numeric counter that the model may add to its answer.
packing: After adding constants or evaluating a polynomial, padded slots may become nonzero. Apply the logical validity mask before concatenation, cross-block motion or reduction where padding could influence a named output.
A positive rotate(k) reads source slot j+k modulo P. Derive each destination from the logical layout; compose only provisioned rotations.
Preserve Linear weights, bias, row/column order and output selectors exactly. Construction requirements do not change the mathematical model.
backend: zero_ct is a genuine client-encrypted zero. Preserve exact zero semantics without depending on transparent self-cancellation or decoding any intermediate. Do not change encryption, runtime checks or keys.
The compiler manages levels, rescale, modswitch and relinearization. A depth/scale capacity rejection is not permission to change safety parameters or model semantics.

type_rules.names: public_constants is request metadata, not a bound runtime dictionary. Only the listed constant keys are prebound. Model-local constant names are not automatically runtime names; map their values through constant_origins. Do not invent pN/cN names.
type_rules.dtype: For public numeric np.array/asarray use the admitted float64 dtype spelling (np.float64, np.double, or the literal string float64). Bare dtype=float is not a supported value expression. float(value) is a separate public conversion call. Expr-containing arrays require dtype=object.
type_rules.shape: Numeric public arrays must be rectangular. Scalar constants and vector masks have different ranks; inspect the declared shapes before combining them. A Plain operand encodes only a scalar or a 1D vector of length 1 or P; explicitly reshape compatible numeric storage first.
type_rules.unary: Unary plus is supported on admitted object-array cells, not on an individual ciphertext Expr. Empty/None cells cannot be used by object-array unary operations. Initialize cells and distinguish public numbers from Plain and ciphertext cells.
type_rules.compare: Ordering and equality require the admitted public scalar/sequence types. Do not compare ciphertexts, arrays, functions or iterators as if they were public numbers. Dictionary key and comparison rules remain restricted.
type_rules.returns: Return the exact number of complete ciphertext expressions in output order. A helper may internally return containers or mixed values, but those are not additional encrypted outputs. Select its admitted ciphertext result before forming golden's flat return.
type_rules.broadcast: Object-array broadcasting is distinct from symbolic scalar arithmetic. A symbolic Expr/Empty left operand does not automatically dispatch object-array broadcasting. Use the admitted array operand forms and compatible ranks.
type_rules.calls: Only registered call signatures and attributes are available. Python/NumPy familiarity is not an allowlist. Starred argument expansion must be in an admitted call form, not an arbitrary expression or comprehension.

typed_request_bindings.scope: Public ABI and registered types only. No model implementation, private test values or deterministic DSL answer. Existing validator, contribution probes, tracing and numerical gates remain authoritative.

precise_construction_rules.identifier_rule: Bindings and helper parameters must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}. Leading underscore, including the common discard name _, is rejected. Use distinct admissible names for unpacking and loop targets. Do not overwrite supplied constants, zero_ct, runtime names or built-ins.
precise_construction_rules.polynomial_rule: Polynomial nodes specify exact coefficients and basis. Equivalent balanced evaluation trees are allowed; all nonzero coefficients, including tiny ones, must remain. The Chebyshev identities T_(2k)=2*T_k*T_k-1 and T_(2k+1)=2*T_k*T_(k+1)-x permit logarithmic-depth basis construction; doubling a ciphertext with addition has the same mathematical value as multiplication by two. Lane-local operations may retain the frozen periodic packing when shapes and output selectors agree. Do not treat padding as logical data during a later reduction or cross-slot operation. No truncation, rescaling of the mathematical model, extra modulus levels or bootstrap is authorized.
precise_construction_rules.authority: Clarification only; unchanged validator, tracing, contribution and numerical gates.

value_and_scale_discipline.constant_bindings: Every graph node retains its own named public constants. Reusing a helper does not authorize reusing another node's bias, weight, gain or coefficient. Pass the exact constants of each call site, even when two nodes have identical shapes or weight values.
value_and_scale_discipline.public_arithmetic: Supplied pN bindings are Plain expressions unless the existing construction contract explicitly converts them to public numeric data. Plain+Plain and Plain*Plain are not native ciphertext arithmetic. Evaluate known public scalar coefficient arithmetic at the admitted public construction stage or use its public literal value; retain every nonzero coefficient. Do not perform it as an operation on two Plain Expr objects.
value_and_scale_discipline.scale_semantics: RuntimePlan declarations are checked against the pinned Poseidon modulus chain and instruction propagation. Multiplication changes scale; rescale drops a real modulus. Modswitch is not a scale conversion. Do not set scale/level, change parameters or use decrypt-reencrypt. Artifact admission does not establish numerical correctness.
value_and_scale_discipline.additive_semantics: Operands added as the same mathematical quantity need matching nominal scale. The runtime's scale metadata override is not a numerical conversion and must not be used to repair a different mathematical scaling.
value_and_scale_discipline.authority: Public clarification only. No test arrays, reference, deterministic DSL solution or extra runtime capability.

expression_construction_rules.native_helpers: Each decorated native function has at most 16 positional parameters. Do not pass every public coefficient as a helper argument: supplied named public constants may be referenced from the helper's trusted lexical scope. Preserve the exact binding at each call site; specialize the helper or split it when calls need different constants. Do not shadow public names, invent dictionaries, or use defaults/varargs.
expression_construction_rules.type_boundary: A supplied Plain Expr is not a public Python scalar. Do not negate a Plain Expr directly: when mathematically appropriate, negate the resulting ciphertext product instead. Public arithmetic is restricted to the selected construction contract.
expression_construction_rules.slot_boundary: Ciphertext indexing is not logical tensor slicing. Object-container cells are whole Expr values. Implement a logical slice using its frozen C-order input/output slot mapping, admitted rotations and public masks; exclude tail padding. Never change the layout to accept Python-style ciphertext indexing.
expression_construction_rules.native_loops: In the native contract, use the admitted bounded range of public integers and admitted container indexing. enumerate, zip, dictionary iteration and list append are not implicit permissions. Use preallocated allowed containers or a compact statically unrolled computation within the AST/work bounds.
expression_construction_rules.depth: Prefer addition for exact ciphertext doubling: reuse the product and add it to itself, rather than multiplying it by an encoded Plain two at every recurrence level. Balanced basis construction alone does not remove the extra depth from Plain multiplications. Preserve every nonzero coefficient, including tiny coefficients, and all node-specific constants.
expression_construction_rules.exact_series_fusion: For Chebyshev series, x*T0(x)=T1(x), and x*Tn(x)=(T(n+1)(x)+T(n-1)(x))/2 for n>=1. These identities permit fusing multiplication by the SAME polynomial argument and a public constant offset into a new exact series before encrypted evaluation. They do not apply to an unrelated ciphertext or across a nonlinear composition. Derive coefficients solely from public model data using admitted public computation or finite allowed literals; retain every contribution. Do not truncate, change the approximation/domain, omit a required helper call, or adjust scale metadata.
expression_construction_rules.response_size: Return only the required candidate JSON. Keep helper signatures and polynomial evaluation compact within the unchanged source/AST/work limits. Do not emit narrative, duplicate unused programs or attempt an unsupported dynamic coefficient algorithm.
expression_construction_rules.authority: Public identities and contract clarification only; no model implementation, test values or reference.

rules.linear_contraction_groups: Linear contracts the input's last axis with the weight's input-feature axis. All leading input coordinates remain separate. Compute every output-feature row with its declared coefficients and bias; neither head/batch groups nor uniform-looking matrix rows imply scalar multiplication.
rules.logical_axis_transforms: Reshape and flatten preserve logical C-order element indices. Permute and transpose change which logical coordinate occupies each flat index. Reshaping an object array rearranges whole Expr cells; it does not move encrypted slots inside those cells. Preserve the coordinate mapping through each transform and every later reduction or broadcast.
rules.ordered_input_coordinates: Input annotations describe only the frozen input binding. Valid logical elements occupy their declared chunk prefix; padding is not another logical feature. A chunk can contain multiple logical rows or groups. Preserve their identities after projections and intermediate transforms. Intermediate ciphertext representations are your choice; named outputs still use the frozen selectors.
rules.public_binding_roles: Only names in public_constants or the explicitly admitted public-weight interface are bound DSL globals. Names under model.constants are logical graph references, not implicit Python variables. Respect the actual bound scalar/vector contents and the exact logical-to-public scalar matches; p-number order has no semantic role. A single-lane packing mask or a masked reduction coefficient is not an all-lane gain, zero bias or replicated scalar. A logical public tensor still needs its declared coordinate mapping; a uniform tensor does not turn matmul into scalar multiplication.

poseidon_expression_rules.backend_constraints: The target is the bound Poseidon CPU RuntimePlan backend. Earth compiler levels count consumed depth; RuntimePlan/Poseidon levels are zero-based data-modulus indices. Compiler admission, artifact admission and numerical acceptance are distinct. Keep the fixed context and requested waterline; bootstrap is unavailable in this context. A compiler rejection does not prove that all equivalent expressions are impossible.
poseidon_expression_rules.scale_semantics: RuntimePlan declarations are checked against the pinned Poseidon modulus chain and instruction propagation. Multiplication changes scale; rescale drops a real modulus. Modswitch is not a scale conversion. Do not set scale/level, change parameters or use decrypt-reencrypt. Artifact admission does not establish numerical correctness.
poseidon_expression_rules.encrypted_zero_rule: zero_ct is a genuine client-encrypted zero. Preserve exact zero semantics without depending on transparent self-cancellation or decoding any intermediate. Do not change encryption, runtime checks or keys.
poseidon_expression_rules.authority: Public graph features and unchanged contracts only; no DSL answer, private input, reference or extra capability.

shape_examples.scope: Public logical shape annotations, not a ciphertext lowering plan

logical_constant_scalar_bindings.scope: Exact equality to already supplied public scalars. Uniform tensor matches apply to its elementwise scalar value only; preserve graph shape and matrix/linear operator semantics. This is not a ciphertext lowering plan.

constant_role_examples.scope: Roles of already supplied public values, not replacement weights

tensor_axis_annotations.scope: Sampled public logical index relations. No encrypted intermediate plan, test values or DSL implementation.

construction_resources.immutable_binding_rule: Keep supplied public constants, zero_ct, runtime names and declared function/helper names unchanged. Use fresh local names for intermediate expressions and distinct public loop indices.

rotation.rule: Call rotate only with one of the supplied admitted_steps. A zero displacement reuses the value. Compose admitted steps for other displacements while preserving the actual slot and chunk mapping; a chunk rotation alone does not implement a rotation of the complete logical tensor.

native.rule: Native static work starts each declared function at the number of supplied public constant bindings, including unused bindings. Each native helper invocation adds that helper's full expanded work plus one. Public range loops are expanded before this count; reusing a local result avoids repeating the call. Share existing intermediates or compose fewer native calls while preserving the complete logical graph. These conservative work units are not ciphertext operation counts, multiplicative depth or runtime memory.
